净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： This factor captures drawdown depth (distance from trailing high), recovery geometry (rate of drawdown decrease), and market roughness (rolling std of returns). The product of these three components amplifies mean-reverting signals when drawdown is deep, recovery is accelerating, and noise is high, reflecting multi-scale complexity in drawdown dynamics.

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_deltan 期差分：x − x_shift(n)
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 window：60
  2. 计算 rolling_high：high.rolling(window=window, min_periods=1).max()
  3. 计算 drawdown：(rolling_high - close) / rolling_high
  4. 计算 dd_change：drawdown.diff()
  5. 计算 recovery_speed：-dd_change / (drawdown + 1e-10)
  6. 计算 roughness：returns.rolling(window=20, min_periods=1).std()
  7. 计算 factor：roughness * drawdown * recovery_speed
  8. 计算 factor：factor
来源：由原始 Python 代码逐句翻译（字段/算子释义见下方）

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_drawdown_recovery_roughness(df): df_copy = df.copy() window = 60 rolling_high = df_copy["str">'high'].rolling(window=window, min_periods=1).max() drawdown = (rolling_high - df_copy["str">'close']) / rolling_high dd_change = drawdown.diff() recovery_speed = -dd_change / (drawdown + 1e-10) returns = df_copy["str">'close'].pct_change() roughness = returns.rolling(window=20, min_periods=1).std() factor = roughness * drawdown * recovery_speed factor = factor.fillna(0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0) factor.name = "str">'factor_drawdown_recovery_roughness' "kw">class="kw">return factor
